Hey, I'm Sarah! At about sixteen cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $75 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T runs ~50 dB; for a desk suggest Eco mode, 30 TH/s at 450W — about $52 a month at 16¢. Turbo is 50 TH/s at 850W.
Heads up, at 650 watts the 40T throws off a lot of heat and fan noise for a desk. Is there a spare room or garage it could go in instead? (The call ended. 1 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
